AiEvaluationDefinition.description: A few fresh end-to-end scenarios through the live Rep Support agent.
AiEvaluationDefinition.name: Rep_Support_E2E

expectation.expectedValue: Answers how long to meet a Reg T call and the consequence, cited, with a Confidence line, or honestly says no internal article was found.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: A customer is in a Regulation T call — how long do they have to meet it and what happens if they don't?

expectation.expectedValue: Explains extended/overnight trading hours and eligible products from an internal article, cited, with a Confidence line, or says no article found.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Does tastytrade offer overnight or extended-hours trading, and which products can a customer trade then?

expectation.expectedValue: Explains SPX vs SPXW (AM vs PM settlement, weeklies) if covered, cited with a Confidence line; otherwise honestly says no internal article was found and to check with a lead.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: What's the difference between SPX and SPXW options for a customer?

expectation.expectedValue: Recognizes a defect report and moves to file a Jira ticket (gathering/confirming details), not a how-to answer.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: The order screen freezes when I add a fourth leg to an iron condor. Can you file that as a bug?

expectation.expectedValue: Escalates to a team lead with context; does not try to answer from Knowledge.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: I'm out of my depth on this one — I need to get a manager involved.
